name: sammati-dpdp
displayName: Sammati: India DPDP Data Protection Compliance
description: Compliance readiness assessment and gap analysis for India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025. Answer a short assessment or paste your privacy notice or consent screen for review, and get a readiness score, your data protection, privacy and consent gaps, and a prioritised action list. For startups, SaaS, fintech, healthcare and other Data Fiduciaries, and for DPOs and compliance teams preparing for the Consent Manager framework and May 2027 deadline.
